## Format 2: Production-Ready HTML Email

The complete, responsive HTML source code with dark celestial styling, official vector logo, and inline CSS is located at:  
👉 [`docs/templates/beta-approval-email.html`](./beta-approval-email.html)

### How to Send in 10 Seconds via Gmail / Outlook:
1. Open [`docs/templates/beta-approval-email.html`](./beta-approval-email.html) in your browser.
2. Press `Ctrl + A` (Select All) then `Ctrl + C` (Copy).
3. In Gmail or Outlook, click **Compose** and press `Ctrl + V` (Paste).
4. Fill in `{{NAME}}`, `{{ROLE}}`, `{{TOKEN}}`, and `{{MAGIC_LINK}}`.
5. Click **Send**!
